name: MIMXRT1060-EVKC
description: Full-featured i.MX RT1062 (600 MHz Cortex-M7) evaluation board with 32 MB SDRAM, 8 MB QSPI + 64 MB HyperFlash, Ethernet, CAN, SD, audio codec, LCD/camera connectors and on-board debug probe.
notes: EVKC is the current active revision (EVKB is no longer manufactured). The NXP product page is the EVKB/EVKC combined page. MCU is MIMXRT1062DVL6B.
i.MX RT has no internal flash: code runs from the 8 MB QSPI or 64 MB HyperFlash (flashMB = 8 + 64). 256 Mb SDRAM is recorded as psramMB = 32.

Parallel LCD and camera connectors are fitted but no display or camera is included (NXP sells a 4.3-inch LCD board separately, about $45). Micro-USB host/OTG ports plus a debug USB port. Board size and GPIO count are approximate.
